'gugs bstims lan gsum zin 'phral/ mdun du til dang g.yas su me g.yon du chu bshams nas/ tshe 'das rnam shes a yig dkar po de: nṛ yig sngo skya kṣa yig dmar skya yi: drwa bas rus pa lpags pa'i tshul du btums: bdag gi thugs las hūm̐ yig dkar po dang: phaṭa yig dmar ser dpag med 'phros pa yis: nṛ dang kṣa yi drwa ba dngos med bshigs: til dang yungs dkar ming byang la bskor/ me chu la dor zhing*/ a nṛ kṣa hūm̐ phaṭa: brgya rtsa brgyad dam bdun sogs brjod/ dkon mchog gsum dang zhi khro rab 'byams kyi: 'dir yi dam gang yin mtshan bsgyur/ bden pa chen pos tshe 'das 'di nyid kyi: 'chi kha'i mtshams sbyor skrag snang 'ur 'jigs kyi: bag chags ngan pa'i gri gcags bral gyur cig: sor mo bsnol ba phyir 'grol ba'i phyag rgyas/ oṃ badzra bandha tra tha: oṃ badzra bhid tra tha: de nas las bum gyi ku shas mtshan byang la gtor zhing*/ oṃ a mṛte hūm̐ phaṭa: me chu nang du blugs la byang bu la lan gsum bskor zhing*/ oṃ badzra bhid tra tha: ces phyir dor/ dri gos mtshan byang tshe 'das lus su gsal: pra we sha ya phaṭa ces lus sgo phyes: nṛ ā we sha ya ā zhes brjod pa yis: rnam par shes pa a yig dngul chu'i mdog: lus la zhugs pas tshe 'das dngos gyur pa'i: snying gar ye shes rdo rje rtse lnga pa: lte bar hūm̐ yig dkar pos mtshan pa la: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥmi 'gyur rgyas btab gyur: rdo rje rtse lnga'i phyag rgya ming byang spyi bor bzhag la/ lus la rdo rje'i go khrab zhu lubs su bkon par gyur: oṃ badzra ka la sha rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐: ming byang spyi bor rdo rje bzhag la/ phyi rol rdo rje'i gur khang chen por gyur: badzra rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐: zhes 'chi kha'i mtshams sbyor gri rigs gang yang rung ba red phyin gri khrol ma byas na tshe 'das la dge rtsa thob tu mi 'jug pa'i bar chad byed ces rgyud gzhung las gsungs pas/
rata gling thugs rje gsang 'dus cha lag las karma chags med kyis bsgrigs pa 'di bzhin 'gro don byed mkhan rnams nas phyag len btang na legs/ sarba maṅga laṃ/// /
